Sandbox_B47ANCEDEyewear_TyingEnabled_too: Allow new eyewear and supported hat ties. Existing ties remain effective and can always be untied. Server setting.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEyewear_EyewearFallMulti: Multiply the default fall values for untied eyewear, including monocles. Range 0.25–5; default 1. Updates worn eyewear without changing tied items. Server setting.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDEyewear_StrappedHeadwear: Fall value for supported strapped protective headwear. Range 0–100; default 0. The vanilla impact calculation still applies. Server setting.
